linkedIn.headline: Creative Director, Writer, and Human
linkedIn.about: I'm a creative leader with extensive experience building brands and managing creative teams. Each brand has a unique story, and it’s my job to bring it to life with emotional, thought-provoking creative that delivers results.

experiences.title: Creative Director
experiences.description:
• Led the US Creative team full of designers and writers.
• Introduced the MPL brand to the US market with a fresh look and tone of voice.
• Provided feedback, managed delivery timelines and drove new initiatives for the creative team.
• Partnered with external agencies on new video campaigns and projects.
• Concepted, scripted and directed in-person photo and video shoots.
• Connected with upper management from multiple teams to align on business goals and timelines.

experiences.title: Copywriter/Screenwriter
experiences.description:
• Work with a variety of brands including health and wellness, fintech and
industrial technology.
• Write scripts for campaign launch videos showcasing new products.
• Establish a new brand voice for product and website launches.
